acceptance.criterion: Implement checked lab/project/membership/placement values with stable identities and explicit ownership/role provenance.
Enforce the agreed state invariants, expected generations and archival rules in a reference catalog; do not embed organization state in immutable releases.
Reject invalid/orphaned references, unauthorized transitions and stale writes with stable problem outcomes.

observed.invalidValues: Unicode code-point limits, controls/unpaired surrogate, blank names and generation overflow rejected
observed.atomicity: unauthorized/orphaned/duplicate/stale/conflicting-intent changes have no partial state or audit; concurrent writers have one winner
observed.authority: separate operator/lab/project/dataset scopes, current retry reauthorization, exact membership basis and non-resurrection, expiry at deadline, last-steward and disablement recovery needs
observed.archival: multiple distinct active leases fenced, creation denied while archived, parent reopen ordering, retained attribution and placements
observed.historicalIdentity: registered scientific datasets/custody/curator IDs unchanged by organization changes

limits: In-memory contract only; no PostgreSQL migration or public organizational API yet.
Production dataset authorization remains the existing implementation until F03; these checks do not establish the 38-case integrated authority gate.
Atomic scientific creation/placement and real durable lease joins belong to F02.2; approved moves, atomic stewardship transfer and public commands remain F02.3.
Verified institutional identities/guest sponsorship remain F04; navigation disclosure remains F05.
No institutional workload, user or pilot acceptance claim.
